'''Issagra''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Issagra system/Legends|Issagra system]]. It was located approximately twelve hours [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel from [[Fether]]. Its most notable location was a large [[Issagra space station|space station]]. Over three [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long, the station was devoted to trade and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], and could house tens of thousands of visitors and hundreds of freighters at a time. The station's atmosphere was often regarded as grand and exotic, though organized crime held sway in the background and contraband could be found in numerous locations.

One of the station's casinos was patronized by the wealthy [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Garoush]].
